name: IKE
content:
Retirement account 
You can invest in stocks, bonds, and other assets. 
If you keep it till retirement, you pay no tax on it, but early withdrawals are taxed 19%.

name: IKZE
content:
Retirement account 
You can invest in stocks, bonds, and other assets. 
You get a tax deduction this year, you pay 10% at retirement withdrawal. 
Early withdrawal costs you 12% or 32%, depending on your tax bracket

name: Mortgage
content:
Home loan 
You lend money from a bank to buy a property, and you pay it back monthly with interest, usually over 20–30 years. 
You have to put in a deposit (around 10–20%), and the home is the bank's security. 
Rates can be fixed or variable, and if you stop paying, the bank can take the property.

name: Bonds
content:
You lend money to a company or government, and they pay you interest. 
You can sell the bond before it matures, but the price may be lower than what you paid.

name: Stocks
content:
You buy a share of a company, and so, you now own a small piece of that company. 
You can make money if the company does well, but if it fails, you can lose the money. 
You can sell the stock at any time, but the price may be lower than what you paid.
